audit_rationale: Core type-changing engine: choosing Rat makes the Snail also a Rat, so Rat-entry triggers plus a free sacrifice outlet can loop through Wick while the token remains a Snail.
Two-mana unconditional Grixis fixing is important because Wick's activated ability requires one mana of each of U/B/R.
High-impact Rat recursion and scaling payoff that restores Rat material while keeping the deck Rat-centric.
Core zero-mana sacrifice outlet; with a Rat type-changer it supports infinite Snail ETB/death loops and produces colorless mana.
Flexible draw, Treasure fixing, and Changeling production; all three modes address Wick setup without requiring the commander.
Efficient sweeper that also synergizes with Tangled Colony by loading damage before its death trigger and can fuel death-based payoffs.
Untapped modal B/R source; both colors are needed for Wick's activated ability.
Target-one drain is the weakest redundant aristocrats payoff; Intruder Alarm adds a deterministic Marrow-Gnawer Rat-token engine and more commander-native combo density.
Fetchable untapped-capable B/R source for Wick casting and activation.
Untapped fetchland that accesses multiple typed dual/shock/triome colors.
Trawler preserves graveyard hate while the back face can function as an untapped black source for 3 life instead of always entering tapped.
One-mana free sacrifice outlet and creature body; directly supports type-changer Snail loops.
Flexible Grixis answer to permanent types the colors otherwise struggle to remove.
Creates multiple Rat bodies and supplies a sacrifice/removal ability; both halves feed Wick's trigger pattern.
Untapped modal U/B source; both colors matter for Wick's activation and interaction.
Best unconditional untapped three-color source in the commander identity.
Same {U}{U} interaction slot, but Mana Drain retains unconditional coverage while converting the countered spell's mana value into next-main-phase acceleration.
Premium asymmetrical interaction; protects combo turns or clears the board without consuming Rat/Snail infrastructure.
Efficient burst acceleration for Wick, type-changer setup, or a multi-piece combo turn.
Free creature interaction while Wick is present preserves mana for the U/B/R activation and protection.
Free protection/stack interaction with the commander in play; unusually valuable on all-in Snail activation turns.
Universal tutor efficiently locates whichever component—Rat engine, type changer, sacrifice outlet, or finisher—is missing.
The list remains adequately ramped after the cut; Altar is a free sacrifice outlet and gives the type-changing Wick package a deterministic mill outlet.
No-budget mana-base upgrade: fetchable B/R typed dual with no check-land condition.
No-budget mana-base upgrade: fetchable U/B typed dual with no check-land condition.
Five-mana Thrull production only becomes Wick-relevant through a type changer; Verminister is a two-mana Rat, naturally triggers Wick, makes more Rats, and supplies Rat-based recursion.
Usually untapped three-color fixing in multiplayer and directly supports U/B/R activation costs.
Marsh Flats immediately fetches Swamp-typed duals/shocks/triome without Fabled Passage's early tapped basic restriction.
Necessary black enchantment interaction plus creature removal; covers an otherwise weak axis.
Two-mana acceleration/fixing remains efficient enough after trimming the Signets.
Free noncreature stack protection when Wick is present; protects deterministic commander-native lines.
Free sacrifice outlet and deterministic damage payoff for Arcane Adaptation/Leyline/Maskwood Snail loops.
Untapped-capable B/R dual; black/red source density remains important after utility-land upgrades.
Both are sacrifice lands, but Tower converts the sacrificed creature into {B}{B}, materially increasing combo-turn efficiency.
Low-cost payoff that converts repeated Rat/Snail token entries from type-changing loops into table-wide damage.
Basic blue source retained to preserve resilience against nonbasic hate and provide unrestricted blue for Wick's activation.
Basic blue source retained to preserve resilience against nonbasic hate and provide unrestricted blue for Wick's activation.
High-ceiling red ritual/card-advantage spell that enables multi-piece optimized turns without requiring a generic cEDH shell.
A Rat that digs for more Rats and supplies toxic pressure; its entry naturally advances Wick's Snail.

Five-mana tribal draw is redundant with Wick's scalable draw engine; Lich's Relic is a one-mana Equipment that can remove a creature/planeswalker from each opponent and adds +2/+1 to the Snail before sacrifice.
Redundant type-changing engine that adds Rat to all creatures, enabling Wick/Snail sacrifice loops while retaining Snail type.
Three-mana Rat that produces repeatable Rat tokens and graveyard disruption; high-value natural Wick trigger density.
Rat-tribal utility with token production/sacrifice flexibility; provides bodies and death synergies at an acceptable rate.
Usually untapped B/R multiplayer dual supporting commander and activation colors.
Premier Rat engine; with Intruder Alarm and enough Rats it deterministically produces arbitrarily many Rat tokens while repeatedly untapping.
Type-changing redundancy plus token production; makes all creature cards/permanents Rats while preserving their existing types.
Every token creation or token sacrifice drains each opponent, making it a deterministic payoff for Wick's token-loop infrastructure.
Usually untapped U/B multiplayer dual supporting commander activation and interaction.
One basic red slot becomes an untapped utility land that can regenerate Wick and other Rats while retaining a mana function.
One basic Mountain is retained for unconditional red production and resilience to nonbasic hate; the other becomes Swarmyard.
Black creature-casting source plus late-game Rat recursion; unusually on-plan utility land.
Nightblade is another overlapping drain payoff; Tainted Strike on Wick turns Wick's noncombat damage into infect, allowing a 10-power Snail activation to give each opponent 10 poison counters.
Five-mana conditional Rat production loses to a one-mana/equip-one counter engine; Blade turns every creature death at the table into permanent Snail power.
Untapped blue source with channel interaction that is difficult to counter and costs no spell slot.
Repeatable Rat production and discard outlet; every copy entering advances Wick and scales the Rat board.
Wick's activated ability specifically needs U/B/R; unconditional untapped any-color production is more valuable than a tapped tribal scry land.
Low-cost Rat with graveyard recursion through Rat attacks; repeatable Rat entry is more useful than one-shot generic recursion.
Core free sacrifice outlet; with a Rat type-changer it makes infinite colored mana through repeated Snail creation and can pivot to Wick's lethal activation.
Cheap Rat plus repeatable Rat-token production and a relevant theft payoff; naturally triggers Wick.
Turns creature deaths into colored-fixing Treasures and supports sacrifice-combo resource loops.

Seven mana and symmetrical life-buying are too slow/risky; Song scales from {X}{R}, creates only your Rats, and gives your creatures haste, producing the same Wick Rat-entry growth at dramatically better rate.
Instant-speed mass-sacrifice/card engine; converts expendable Rats into cards and protects value from sweepers.
Untapped fetchland with broad U/B/R typed-land access.
The deck can surrender one two-mana rock; Intent turns expendable Rats/Snails into the exact type-changer, outlet, payoff, or protection piece required.
Natural Rat entry plus repeated Rat production when nontoken creatures leave; token-sacrifice draw is additional infrastructure.
Creates two Rat tokens on ETB and later converts spare bodies into counters and impulse cards; three relevant bodies/effects in one slot.
Five mana to copy cast tribal spells is slow and misses tokens; The Ozolith costs one and preserves the Snail's accumulated +1/+1 counters after it is sacrificed.
Untapped modal U/R source for Wick activation and interaction.
Choose Rat: the Throne itself enters as a Rat and doubles triggered abilities of other Rats, including Wick's Rat-entry trigger, while ward improves resilience.
Untapped fetchland with broad U/R/B typed-land access.
Combat-wide Rat pump is secondary to Wick's signature Snail sacrifice; Bulk Up directly doubles Snail power before Wick's activation and can be flashed back.
Untapped-capable U/B source retained after the mana-base upgrade because colored activation density is more important than another colorless utility land.
Untapped U/R painland; unrestricted colored mana can pay Wick's U/B/R activation unlike Cavern's tribal mana.
Exceptional low-cost draw with 1/1 Rat tokens and remains functional before Wick is established.
Four mana for Goblins and a Goblin-only outlet is less native; Voracious Vermin is a Rat and creates another Rat, producing two Wick Rat-entry triggers for three mana.
Untapped red source whose channel mode creates sacrifice/pressure bodies at low opportunity cost.
Best legal generic acceleration into a four-mana commander and expensive engine turns.
Fetchable untapped-capable U/R source.
Untapped-capable U/R source retained to keep activation-color density high after adding several utility lands.
No-budget mana-base upgrade: fetchable U/R typed dual with no check-land condition.
Untapped B/R painland with unrestricted activation colors.
One basic black slot becomes Rat-tribal cast protection/fixing; Cavern makes Wick and other Rat creature spells of the chosen type uncounterable.
One basic Swamp is retained for unconditional black production and resilience to nonbasic hate; the other becomes Cavern of Souls.
One-mana protection against many sweepers, removal spells, and combo pieces; essential efficiency for setup turns.
Two-mana untapped U/R fixing; pays two distinct Wick activation colors.
Two-mana untapped U/B fixing; pays two distinct Wick activation colors.
Two-mana untapped B/R fixing; pays two distinct Wick activation colors.
Creature removal remains deep; replacing the two-mana creature-only answer with a one-mana noncreature counter improves protection of the commander-native combo turns.
Natural Rat that rewards creature deaths with Rat tokens and supplies additional sacrifice pressure; multiple Wick-relevant axes.
Three-mana scalable sweeper remains the fastest reset despite not being commander-specific; necessary defensive efficiency.
Usually untapped U/R multiplayer dual.
Rat-specific attack payoff that drains each opponent and gains life; natural tribal finisher rather than generic aristocrats redundancy.
One-mana universal tutor maximizes access to compact commander-native engines.
One-mana free sacrifice outlet with card selection; key redundancy for type-changer Snail loops.
Rat-specific exile/replacement engine that can generate a large Rat army from opposing deaths while advancing Wick.
Fetchable untapped-capable U/B source.
Wave is a four-mana combat-conditional recursion body; Tangled Colony is a two-mana Rat whose death can create a burst of Rat entries, especially after damage-based sweepers.
Fetchable tri-land fixes all Wick colors; one tapped tri-land is justified by three-color activation demands.
Two-mana each-opponent drain payoff that turns repeated sacrifice loops into deterministic table kills.
